text: At the 65th minute, Kingsmoor FC, trailing 2-3, shifts their approach by pressing higher and playing more direct. They push their defensive line forward near the middle of the pitch, aiming to win the ball closer to Westport Albion’s goal at the far end. Their wide players on left and right flanks look to receive quicker passes and deliver crosses into the box just outside the penalty area. This more aggressive style increases their box presence but also leads to more turnovers, as Kingsmoor tries to create chances swiftly. [#1187]
